title: PRESIDENT OF INDIA REVIEWS THE PASSING OUT PARADE OF AUTUMN TERM 2026 AT THE INDIAN NAVAL ACADEMY, EZHIMALA
subtitle: THE SECURITY OF MARITIME ROUTES IS CLOSELY LINKED TO THE ECONOMIC WELL-BEING OF NATIONS AND THE EVERYDAY LIVES OF THEIR PEOPLE: PRESIDENT DROUPADI MURMU
body_text: The President of India, Smt Droupadi Murmu reviewed the Passing Out Parade of Autumn Term 2026 at the Indian Naval Academy, Ezhimala, Keralam today (November 28, 2026). Speaking on the occasion, the President congratulated all the trainees, including from the Indian Coast Guard and friendly foreign countries, for successfully completing their training. She said that it was heartening to see many young women among the graduating trainees. Their presence is a matter of pride for the entire nation. They have demonstrated that determination, courage and competence know no boundary. She underlined that their achievements will inspire many more young women to dream big and take up challenging responsibilities in the service of the nation. The President said that the maritime domain has become increasingly important in today's interconnected world. A large part of global trade moves through the seas. The security of maritime routes is, therefore, closely linked to the economic well-being of nations and the everyday lives of their people. Any disruption in the movement of ships can affect the supply of essential goods, increase costs and ultimately place an additional burden on ordinary citizens. She advised trainees to remember that their service at sea is connected to the lives of people on land. It contributes directly to the security, prosperity and well-being of the people. The President said that integrity, professional competence, courage and compassion of young cadets will define the character of the Indian Navy. At sea, they will face challenging weather, long deployments and uncertain situations. They will have to take difficult decisions, often under pressure. She advised them to always remember that leadership is not merely about giving commands; it is about undertaking responsibility, setting an example and standing by those who serve with them. She expressed confidence that their training, adaptability and commitment will prepare them to face the future challenges. The President said that the uniform cadets wear carries the trust and expectations of more than a billion Indians. Every citizen, irrespective of where they live or what they do, looks towards our Armed Forces with confidence and pride.
